Hospitality & Tourism

Hotels, restaurants, attractions and destinations in Qatar serve residents, business travellers and international visitors. Demand moves with the season, the events calendar, and Ramadan and Eid. Guests make their choice from what they find on search, maps, review sites and social media.

Glimpse manages that presence for you. We keep Google Business Profile listings and local search results accurate, monitor and answer reviews, plan seasonal campaigns, and arrange influencer visits that show the experience as it is.

Content is produced in Arabic and English, with photography and video shot on your property, so every channel shows the standard a guest will find on arrival.

How we help

  • SEO. Local SEO and Google Business Profile management for each property, outlet and attraction.
  • Reputation Management. Review monitoring and considered replies across platforms, with recurring issues passed to your operations team.
  • Influencer Management. Hosted visits from vetted creators, with clear briefs, agreed deliverables and proper disclosure.
  • Social Media. Seasonal content calendars that cover Ramadan, Eid, Qatar National Day and the peak visitor months.
  • Advertising. Campaigns for room nights, table bookings and ticket sales, timed to seasonal demand.
  • Photography. Rooms, dishes, venues and experiences photographed on site, with video for social and advertising.

Preparing for the next season or opening a new venue? Contact the Glimpse Qatar team.
